subject: bindinfo, planner: restore binding match cache for plan cache (#65766)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent focusing on planner plan-cache key and binding-match behavior. `NewPlanCacheKey` now calls `bindinfo.MatchSQLBinding` directly (equivalent semantics to the removed wrapper) and still incorporates matched `BindSQL` into the plan-cache key; `MatchSQLBinding` continues to use per-statement `StmtCtx` caching so binding selection is consistent across key generation and optimization within the same statement. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/concurrency issues found in the planner path; later upstream commit `01935b751f` adds normalization reuse for performance, not a correctness fix.
